description: This Java class 'ContentImageController' is a Spring MVC controller that manages static content images in an e-commerce application. It provides endpoints for browsing, listing, adding, and removing content images associated with merchant stores, and handles content file uploads and deletions.

classes.name: ContentImageController
classes.description: Spring MVC controller that manages content images including listing, uploading, and deleting images related to merchant content, with appropriate authorization checks.

methods.name: displayFileBrowser
methods.description: Returns the view for the file browser used in the content editor.

methods.name: getContentImages
methods.description: Returns the view displaying content images for a merchant store.

methods.name: pageImages
methods.description: Returns a JSON response containing paginated list of image file paths and info for a store.

methods.name: displayContentImagesCreate
methods.description: Displays the form for uploading new content images.

methods.name: saveContentImages
methods.description: Handles uploading and saving new content images for a merchant store.

methods.name: removeImage
methods.description: Deletes a specified image file from the merchant store content.

methods.name: setMenu
methods.description: Sets menu attributes on the model for UI navigation.
